spans.s: And there is diversely the लुक् elision of यङ् -- धातोरेकाचो हलादेः क्रियासमभिहारे यङ्
, when the affix अच् -- नन्दिग्रहिपचादिभ्यो ल्युणिन्यचः

The feminine affix चाप् comes after a stem which is formed by the affix ञ्यङ् or ष्यङ्।

Terms: विभक्ति-चाप्

The पित् सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant, optionally get the augment इट् in the Intensive.

Terms: इट् augment

गुण is substituted for the final ऋ in those roots ending in ऋ in which the vowel is preceded by a conjunct consonant, when the Intensive character यङ् follows.

Terms: गुण
